inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Entra QR Code Sign-In KQL Detection

properties.description:
This rule detects when an admin updates a user’s QR code PIN authentication method in Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) within the last 1 hour.

Since QR code–based authentication methods can be abused if modified without proper change management, this detection helps identify suspicious or unauthorized changes to user authentication settings.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Entra QR Code Sign-In KQL Detection
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Category == "UserManagement"
| where ActivityDisplayName == "Admin updated security info"
| where ResultDescription == "Admin changed QRcode Pin Authentication Method for user"
